_comment: Copy to config.json and edit. config.json is gitignored — never commit it.
_event_files_comment: Optional. A list of NDJSON logs merged into one view (overrides event_file). Paths expand ~; missing files are tolerated. Example: ["~/.agent-command-center/events.jsonl", "./events.jsonl"].
title: Agent Command Center
_actions_comment: How the dashboard handles approvals. 'readonly' (default, safe): view only, no acting buttons. 'browser': in-page Approve/Revise/Decline that POST to the authenticated write-back endpoint — keep behind a private mesh + single user. 'telegram': actions hand off to the configured Telegram chat (needs the telegram block below). 'both': browser buttons AND the Telegram hand-off note (same browser-mode security tradeoff).
_actions_token_comment: Only used when actions_mode is 'browser' or 'both'. Shared secret the browser sends with each decision. Leave null to auto-generate one per server start (printed on boot). Set a stable value to keep it across restarts.
_content_comment: How reviewable draft content reaches the dashboard. 'inline' (default): the full draft travels in the event's 'content' array. 'reference': events carry a 'content_ref' pointer and the dashboard reads the draft from disk — keeps the event log lean and out of telemetry.
_content_dir_comment: Sandbox root for reference-mode draft files. null → the directory containing event_file. Referenced paths must stay inside this directory.
_corrections_comment: Where Revise+Submit decisions are logged (original + diff + optional reason). Separate from the event stream and gitignored.
_view_comment: What / serves: 'sessions' (default; one row per session, needs-you first, phone friendly) or 'classic' (agent cards and the browser approvals workflow). Both stay reachable at /sessions and /classic.
_claude_app_links_comment: macOS + Claude desktop app: add 'Open in Claude' to sessions waiting on you, opening that session in the app. Reads only two id fields (sessionId, cliSessionId) from the app's per-session records under ~/Library/Application Support/Claude/claude-code-sessions. The app's record format is not a public API and may change; if it does, the buttons simply disappear.
